unit: one player/game at middle window, one fixed 2.5 line Over quote then alphabetic book; other lines descriptive only

studies.name: timestamped_features
studies.missing: explicit missing category; paired comparisons only on same available player games
studies.selection: development only; separately test each feature before any combination

studies.name: zero_current_history
studies.shadow: prior30 NB20 without current history, min20 prior games

studies.name: rookies
studies.shadow: position prior learned exclusively in development; recent10 after minimum5 appearances
studies.cohort: all exactly matched roster players with fewer than20 prior appearances; never substitute cohort players

studies.name: team_changes
studies.definition: target team differs from last earlier appearance team
studies.shadow: frozen forecast vs current-team-only history where >=10 current-team appearances

studies.name: role_changes
studies.definition: earlier recent3 TOI / previous7 TOI outside [0.8,1.2], minimum10 earlier appearances
studies.shadow: frozen mean vs mean scaled by recent3/previous7 TOI ratio clipped [0.8,1.2]

primary_metric: paired Brier difference at same player/game/line
uncertainty: 1000 player-cluster bootstrap samples, seed1847; minimum20 players and100 player-games per study
reporting: coverage, missingness, cohort strata, log loss, calibration, paired Brier; no profitability claim
promotion: requires completed fresh validation with frozen development implementation/config hashes and written review; cannot tune to already inspected 20242025 results
final_holdout_gate: requires explicit future authorization and immutable development artifact hash; no current script opens final holdout
feature_model_form: Independent categorical rate multiplier (sum actual SOG +20)/(sum frozen expected SOG +20) for each observed category; projected TOI bins of5 minutes; line_assignment captures listed-linemates coverage, not rank. Missing/unseen categories excluded from paired feature comparison.
multiple_comparisons: Five single-feature comparisons are descriptive; intervals do not adjust for all selection uncertainty.
